items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I heard him at the Savoy. He had Sidney DeParis in that band I remember but I don't think you were in there.

ctx.x: A very good band, may I say.

I heard him at the Savoy. He had Sidney DeParis in that band I remember but I don't think you were in there. I wonder where you were in '37. See, this is what we said that I never heard you in person so I must have been missing you somehow.
Well, maybe you didn't look for me. I was right there in '37 with Willy Bryant's band. Oh, yeah, the Savoy, too.
